name: Other Collateral 11
definition: Provides details about the letter of credit or bank guarantee, or other collateral, posted as collateral.

CollateralIdentification.name: Collateral Identification
CollateralIdentification.definition: Provides the identification of the proposed collateral.

AssetNumber.name: Asset Number
AssetNumber.definition: Identifies the register number of the collateral deposit assigned by the central counterparty.

LetterOfCreditIdentification.name: Letter Of Credit Identification
LetterOfCreditIdentification.definition: Provides the unique identification of the letter of credit.

OtherTypeOfCollateral.name: Other Type Of Collateral
OtherTypeOfCollateral.definition: Provides a description and an amount of another type of collateral.

IssueDate.name: Issue Date
IssueDate.definition: Date on which the other collateral was issued.

ExpiryDate.name: Expiry Date
ExpiryDate.definition: Date on which the other collateral expires.

LimitedCoverageIndicator.name: Limited Coverage Indicator
LimitedCoverageIndicator.definition: Indicates that the collateral deposited in the clearing house covers the margin until a specific timeframe.

Issuer.name: Issuer
Issuer.definition: Party that issues the bank guarantee or letter of / documentary credit.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Valuation date of the other collateral when it was taken as collateral.

MarketValue.name: Market Value
MarketValue.definition: Value of the collateral based on current market prices.

Haircut.name: Haircut
Haircut.definition: Haircut or valuation factor on the collateral expressed as a percentage.

CollateralValue.name: Collateral Value
CollateralValue.definition: Value of the collateral after taking into account the haircut, if any.

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Place where the securities are safe-kept, physically or notionally. This place can be, for example, a local custodian, a Central Securities Depository (CSD) or an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD).

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Ru.definition: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Ru.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.
